The year under review reflects the Company’s tesilience, disciplined execution, and continued commitment to sound governance, even amid a challenging and evolving economic environment. Future Outlook The sugarcane crushing season 2025-26 commenced on November 15, 2025.
Based on crop assessments and expected recovery trends, sugar production is going to be around 15% higher than last year.
Sugarcane prices are anticipated to remain firm, reflecting higher input costs incurred by growers.
